##### Project general facts

Alder at Park Five is the final residential phase of a master-planned community, offering a contemporary collection of one-, two-, and three-bedroom apartments. The project features modern mid-rise architecture with refined façades, spacious balconies, and thoughtfully designed residences that prioritize functionality and comfort. Open-plan layouts, abundant natural light, and carefully planned interior spaces create a modern living environment suited to both end users and investors. The development emphasizes quality construction, efficient space utilization, and a contemporary residential experience.

Residents have access to a wide range of lifestyle amenities, including a swimming pool, fully equipped gym, children's play areas, community lounges, barbecue areas, and shaded social spaces. Additional recreational facilities include jogging and walking paths, as well as landscaped outdoor areas designed for relaxation, exercise, and community interaction. The amenity offering supports a balanced lifestyle focused on wellness, leisure, and social engagement.

The residences feature high-end finishes and premium materials throughout the living spaces and bathrooms. Interiors are designed to maximize natural light and are complemented by carefully selected fixtures and fittings. All apartments are equipped with a smart home system. Kitchens include built-in appliances. Residences are delivered without furniture. The overall specification reflects modern finishing with high-quality materials and contemporary technological integration.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Production City (DPC) is a vibrant community designed to foster creativity and innovation, primarily catering to the media, production, and publishing industries. Strategically located near key highways, it offers excellent connectivity to Dubai’s major hubs, including the Dubai Marina and Al Maktoum International Airport. The area is characterized by its modern infrastructure, tailored to meet the needs of businesses, while also offering a dynamic environment for professionals and residents alike.

Beyond its business focus, Dubai Production City provides a balanced lifestyle with a range of amenities. Residential complexes within the district feature contemporary designs and cater to a diverse community. With parks, retail outlets, cafes, and fitness centers, the area promotes a lifestyle of convenience and leisure. Educational institutions and healthcare facilities within close reach further enhance its appeal as a well-rounded community.

DPC also emphasizes sustainability and green living, integrating eco-friendly practices into its design. Lush landscapes and open spaces are thoughtfully incorporated, providing a refreshing environment for residents and visitors. Whether you’re a business professional seeking a dynamic workspace or a family looking for a vibrant neighborhood, Dubai Production City offers a unique blend of innovation, comfort, and connectivity.
